newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Corporacion Geo raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Corporacion Geo raised.

text.p: Caspian Research on Friday upgraded Mexican construction firm Corporacion Geo SA de CV to buy from market performer.
--"We expect Geo's primary share offering on June 17 to be successful," analyst Sebastien Chatel wrote in a report.

--Chatel said Geo has lagged behind the Mexican market in the past eight months, but mostly because of concerns over the company's working capital, which "should be to a large extent resolved" once the offering goes through.
--"We now find the shares attractive and are upgrading our rating," the report said.
--Chatel also said "the home-building sector as a whole is still attractively valued."
--Corporacion Geo was trading 2.20 pesos higher at 41 pesos in late trade on Friday.
